body:
Fix round (review blocker: ribbon covered the bottom-right control legend). Pushed 57c67557, still a draft.

- The ribbon moves from the bottom centre to the bottom-left corner (`bar_rect`). The legend keeps the bottom-right, and the legend string and anchor are now shared with the shell (`viewport_bar::LEGEND`, `legend_anchor`).
- Why this and not lifting the legend: lifting puts the hovered legend over the empty-document line on every pane. Moving the ribbon changes one row.
- Pin: `viewport_bar::tests::legend_clears_the_ribbon` measures the legend with the Small text style against the ribbon on a 700 x 600 and a 1600 x 900 pane. `law_tests::the_hud_is_laid_out_from_the_pane_alone` now pins the left corner.
- Residual, stated in the decision note: below about 490 px the two still meet (ribbon plus legend plus margins). Not fixed in this round.
- Empty-document line: unchanged. Its clearance to the ribbon is the same as before, so not made worse.
- Quick gate green on the final run; two compile errors and one test panic in the new test code were fixed first.

Conflicts with main since PR #1204 merged (`viewcube.rs`: #1204 added the Pick through button to the nav column this PR moves into the bottom bar). Per the maintainer's rule of 2026-11-12 (refresh only at merge time, #1221) it is NOT refreshed now: it is a `feat` that merges at the next cut. At that point one refresh moves the Pick through button into `viewport_bar.rs` (and makes the layout test check the last button, as #1204's review noted), and one review covers that refresh together with the still-unreviewed hint-overlap fix `57c67557`.

refreshed against main 37482923. Merge commit fdcfff5b (parents 57c67557 and 37482923), pushed, still a draft.

**Conflict and resolution.** The only conflict was `crates/ui/src/egui_app/viewcube.rs`: #1204 added the Pick through button (`Nav::PickThrough`) to the nav column this PR moves out. `viewcube.rs` now keeps no nav column (our side taken whole). Main's additions were ported into `viewport_bar.rs`: the variant, the six-entry `NAVS` (sized by `NAV_COUNT`), `pick_through_label` (re-exported to `viewcube` for the tests only), the act arm (toggles `state.pick_through`, sets the status line), the active state (off by default) and the glyph. No other hunk had to be merged by hand.

**Bar width and overlap.** Six buttons: 188 px wide. Measured legend width 242.75 px at the Small style. The ribbon and legend overlap only on panes narrower than about **453 px** (198 + 12 + 242.75), not the ~490 px the earlier note said; the decision note now says so and gives 423 px as the threshold with five buttons. `legend_clears_the_ribbon` still holds at 700 x 600 and 1600 x 900.

**Tests.** The four `pick_through` tests are unchanged in their assertions: `the_pick_through_button_is_off_by_default_and_labelled_in_plain_english`, `the_toggle_flips_twice_back_to_off_and_queues_no_command`, `with_the_toggle_off_a_click_over_a_hidden_edge_never_picks_the_edge`, `with_the_toggle_on_a_click_over_a_hidden_edge_reaches_the_far_side_edge`. The layout law test counts buttons from `NAVS` and checks the last one is inside the bar; `bar_fits_its_buttons` counts from the list too. `viewcube::min_width()` now gives the hud gate.

**Gate.** `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main` green on its first full run on the final tree (7 steps, 0 failed). Earlier runs failed on the new test code and on a law-test width, both fixed. `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean.

<!-- review-cost: fdcfff5b -->
**Estimated agent cost to merge-ready:** ~$0.76 (334k tokens)
| Run | Model | Tokens | Est. cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| work + fix round + refresh (cumulative) | Haiku 5.5 | 204k | ~$0.03 |
| review + re-review (cumulative) | Opus 5.5 | 130k | ~$0.73 |
Blended upper estimate (90 % input / 10 % output at list price; cache reads make the real cost lower). Main-session coordination isn't counted.

Effort: effort:high (not escalated). Agent-tier trial, issue 5. Merges at the next minor cut (feat).

Not merged - the maintainer, at the merge question (2026-11-12): "No it should not be bottom-left . it should have been bottom-center floating ontop of the 3D viewer". So the bar goes back to bottom-centre, floating over the viewport (as issue #1198 says: "a floating control bar at the bottom of the viewport"), and it is the control hint that must give way where the two would meet, not the bar. Back to draft for that fix round.

Maintainer fix round (2026-11-12): "No it should not be bottom-left . it should have been bottom-center floating ontop of the 3D viewer". Pushed b46aab84, still a draft.

**Layout rule** (`viewport_layout::place`, pure on the pane, the view cube and the measured sizes):
1. The ribbon is centred on the bottom edge and has priority.
2. The control legend stays at the bottom-right while it clears the ribbon by 8 px; otherwise it sits on its own line directly above the ribbon, right-aligned.
3. The empty-document line is centred at its base height; it lifts above the ribbon if it meets it, then above the legend if the legend is drawn and it meets that too.
4. A piece that would meet the view cube, or leave the pane, is not drawn.

**Where the legend lifts:** below a pane width of about **714 px** (single line, 242.75 px at the Small style). It wraps onto more lines below about **267 px**; the hud minimum is about 208 px, where the legend wraps and lifts.

**Tests:** `viewport_layout::tests::legend_clears_the_ribbon` (1600 x 900, 700 x 600, and `viewcube::min_width()` x 260, each with and without a model: no pair of ribbon, legend, empty-document line and cube overlaps, all inside the pane); `viewport_bar::tests::bar_fits_its_buttons`; `law_tests::view_cube_tests::the_hud_is_laid_out_from_the_pane_alone`; the four `egui_app::tests::pick_through` tests unchanged.

**Gate:** `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main` green on its first run (ui suites, 0 failed). `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean.

Not exercised: nothing was looked at on screen; the rule is pinned by rects measured with the frame's fonts.

<!-- review-cost: b46aab84 -->
**Estimated agent cost to merge-ready:** ~$1.01 (434k tokens): work + two fix rounds + refresh, Haiku 5.5, 260k, ~$0.04; review + three re-reviews, Opus 5.5, 174k, ~$0.97. Blended upper estimate (90 % input / 10 % output at list price). Effort: effort:high. Merged on the maintainer's yes ahead of the cut.
